videos.title: Gutfeld!
videos.overview: Greg Gutfeld looks at the news of the day through a satiric lens fused with pop culture and features his takes on the day's headlines.

videos.title: Live: Fox News at Night
videos.overview: Hard news and analysis of compelling stories from Washington, D.C., and across the country; journalists provide viewers with must-see information and consequential news.

videos.title: The Five
videos.overview: Dana Perino, Greg Gutfeld and Jesse Watters and rotating liberal co-hosts Jessica Tarlov and Harold Ford Jr. discuss and debate the hot issues across the spectrum from politics to pop culture.

videos.overview: Jesse Watters speaks with newsmakers from across the U.S. to present news with a clear and direct approach.
